item.title: 【Singles (lossless)】Pink Flyod - The Wall Collection (not the entire album) dts hd ma 7.1 UPMIX
item.description:
hey guys!!! ive uploaded a few upmixes here with a few listeners but sadly not many. when i first started makeing mixes i diddnt know much and was just learning now awhile later i know alot. now i can even create phantom channels for the use with downmixing to 5.1 or even quadrophonic dts systems. so i hope you all enjoy my collection of pink flyods the wall tracks upmixed too dts hd ma 7.1 surround sound!!!! DISCLAIMER i had too downsample the original tracks too 24bit 48000hz as my upmixer cannot handle higher sample rates. however thare is not a considerable loss in audio fedility quality or overall volume so u wont notice it. just thought id put this here for the audiophiles ASWELL please make sure to use a dts decoder and dont transcode these tracks. or youll ruin the rear phantom imageing i have encoded in these tracks to make sure users with any channel count (even 3.1) get the best surround sound experince

ENJOYYY AND PLEASE LEAVE FEEDBACK I WANNA HEAR HOW YOU GUYS LIKE THESE OR IF U DONT AND WHAT U LIKE OR DONT LIKE
